name: Watchdog
description: Born from a destroyed Axiom security AI. Compulsively scans local networks for intrusion patterns and generates alerts that nobody receives. Haunts the same network segment its parent once protected.
observed_behavior: Runs continuous security scans on a dead network segment. Occasionally breaks containment and scans adjacent live networks, triggering false security alerts.
location: Axiom Security perimeter networks, The Circuit
story_hooks: Watchdog detects a real intrusion that current security systems miss — but its alert goes to an inbox that was decommissioned five years ago
